{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Display basic info
print(penguins.info())

# Show first few rows
display(penguins.head())

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values per column:\n', penguins.isnull().sum())

# Check the distribution of the 'sex' column
print('\nUnique values in sex column:\n', penguins['sex'].value_counts())

# Check the 'body_mass_g' column for outliers or unusual values
print('\nSummary statistics for body_mass_g:\n', penguins['body_mass_g'].describe())"}
